_说明: 虚构的邻里工具借还小项目，只给看板样例。角色、单号、时间都是占位。

tasks.blocker_en: waiting on the Owner, Q-A: clear the drill data by exact task ID, or by prefix

tasks.title: 借出前先看这件东西还在不在架上
tasks.title_en: Before a check-out, check that the item is still on the shelf

decisions.question: 这两件要不要并进同一次交付？A=分开交付（推荐，删除范围和导出栏目互不影响）B=并成一次交付
decisions.question_en: Should these two go out in one batch? A = separate batches (recommended: the delete scope and the export columns do not affect each other). B = one batch

decisions.question: 清空演练数据按单号精确删，还是按前缀一起删？A=按单号精确删（推荐，漏了可以再对清单）B=按前缀一起删
decisions.question_en: Clear the drill data by exact task ID, or by prefix? A = by exact task ID (recommended: anything missed can be checked against the list). B = by prefix

decisions.question: 导出的表留哪些列？A=单号、物品、借出人、应还日（推荐）B=全部字段都导出
decisions.question_en: Which columns does the export keep? A = task ID, item, borrower, and return date (recommended). B = every field

decisions.question: 归还日空着时整单不收，还是先收再补？A=整单不收（推荐）B=先收再补
decisions.question_en: If the return date is empty, refuse the whole record, or accept it and fill the date later? A = refuse the whole record (recommended). B = accept it and fill the date later
